request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Make it a far bigger command mothership filling the image from left to right edge: a huge thick chrome hull of three stacked decks, the middle deck with a row of lit magenta windows, the lower deck with a ring of big magenta lights, the upper deck with a big chrome command dome with dark windows and an antenna; a very big magenta beam port under it. No pilot, no legs; empty space stays under it. Keep the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
